verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented data-export feature: no account export, no bulk download, and no open-format (CSV/ICS/JSON) dump of bookings, event types or schedules. The REST API, MCP server and CLI are developer building blocks for scheduling operations, not an export capability. The MIT-licensed Cal.diy fork and GDPR compliance claims are adjacent to the story and do not show a way to export all of a user's data and leave.
